title: 船閘人字門安裝
subcategoryTitle: 海岸、港灣與水資源韌性
summary: 以水壓傳力支承對位和機電幾何理解人字門安裝驗證。課程從邊界辨識與資料整理走到水理量化、構造介面及驗證紀錄；每一步把計算結果連回可量測的證據。十個不同單元分別處理關鍵機制，不以名義尺寸或單一通過率代替整體工程判斷，並明列合成算例與現地資料的差別。
summaryEn: Understand miter-gate installation through pressure paths, bearing alignment and actuator geometry. The course moves from boundary identification and evidence to hydraulic quantification, structural interfaces and verification records. Ten distinct units connect each calculated quantity to measurable evidence. Nominal geometry or a single pass rate does not establish whole-system performance, and synthetic teaching examples remain separate from field observations.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「雙側靜水荷載」與「門葉斜角與跨度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Two-sided hydrostatic loading" and "Leaf angle and projected span": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 雙側靜水荷載：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Two-sided hydrostatic loading: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「雙側靜水荷載」如何影響船閘人字門安裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Two-sided hydrostatic loading” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Miter-gate installation for navigation locks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 人字門關閉後由門葉及接觸支承傳遞水壓，水壓分布需分別從兩側水深計算。每米寬的垂直平面條帶可以先建立荷載量級，但門葉斜角、水平主梁與接觸不連續會改變實際傳力；不能把條帶合力直接當成啟閉機的推力需求。 假設淡水、同底面兩側深8與6m，垂直平面每米寬淨力F=ρg(8²−6²)/2=137.34kN/m；非致動器推力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「雙側靜水荷載」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Closed miter gates transfer water pressure through leaves and contact supports, with pressure integrated separately for both water depths. A vertical plane strip per unit width provides an initial load scale. Leaf angle, horizontal girders and discontinuous contact alter real transfer, so the strip resultant cannot directly become the force required of the operating machinery during gate movement. Assume freshwater and depths8and6m above the same base. Net force per metre of vertical plane is137.34kN/m, not actuator thrust. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Two-sided hydrostatic loading” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「閉門靜水合力可以不經力路徑分析直接當成啟閉機推力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The closed-gate hydrostatic resultant directly equals actuator thrust without load-path analysis." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「雙側靜水荷載」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Two-sided hydrostatic loading”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 雙側靜水荷載
knowledge.text: 人字門關閉後由門葉及接觸支承傳遞水壓，水壓分布需分別從兩側水深計算。每米寬的垂直平面條帶可以先建立荷載量級，但門葉斜角、水平主梁與接觸不連續會改變實際傳力；不能把條帶合力直接當成啟閉機的推力需求。
knowledge.textEn: Closed miter gates transfer water pressure through leaves and contact supports, with pressure integrated separately for both water depths. A vertical plane strip per unit width provides an initial load scale.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：閉門靜水合力可以不經力路徑分析直接當成啟閉機推力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The closed-gate hydrostatic resultant directly equals actuator thrust without load-path analysis. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「雙側靜水荷載」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Two-sided hydrostatic loading" is correct?
options: 閉門靜水合力可以不經力路徑分析直接當成啟閉機推力。
人字門關閉後由門葉及接觸支承傳遞水壓，水壓分布需分別從兩側水深計算。
門葉實長永遠等於船閘淨寬的一半而不受斜角影響。
optionsEn: The closed-gate hydrostatic resultant directly equals actuator thrust without load-path analysis.
Closed miter gates transfer water pressure through leaves and contact supports, with pressure integrated separately for both water depths.
Each miter leaf length always equals half the clear lock width regardless of its angle.
quiz.explanation: 人字門關閉後由門葉及接觸支承傳遞水壓，水壓分布需分別從兩側水深計算。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Closed miter gates transfer water pressure through leaves and contact supports, with pressure integrated separately for both water depths. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 雙側靜水荷載：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Two-sided hydrostatic loading: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雙側靜水荷載」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Two-sided hydrostatic loading” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設淡水、同底面兩側深8與6m，垂直平面每米寬淨力F=ρg(8²−6²)/2=137.34kN/m；非致動器推力。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume freshwater and depths8and6m above the same base. Net force per metre of vertical plane is137.34kN/m, not actuator thrust. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：畫出兩側水壓圖與共同底面，將合力及力矩沿門葉傳到斜接及側枕接觸，確認單位寬度方向。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Draw both pressure diagrams on one base and trace resultant and moment through leaf, miter and quoin contacts, defining unit-width direction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設淡水、同底面兩側深8與6m，垂直平面每米寬淨力F=ρg(8²−6²)/2=137.34kN/m；非致動器推力。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume freshwater and depths8and6m above the same base. Net force per metre of vertical plane is137.34kN/m, not actuator thrust.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「雙側靜水荷載」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Two-sided hydrostatic loading", which statement holds?
options: 排水後門葉支承仍只承受與完全浸水時相同的有效重量。
上下兩點量測吻合就可以排除軸線所有彎曲和局部錯位。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: After dewatering, supports carry only the same effective weight as during full submergence.
Matching two pivot endpoints excludes all shaft curvature and local misalignment.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 雙側靜水荷載：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Two-sided hydrostatic loading: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「雙側靜水荷載」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Two-sided hydrostatic loading” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 畫出兩側水壓圖與共同底面，將合力及力矩沿門葉傳到斜接及側枕接觸，確認單位寬度方向。另查啟閉時水頭條件和機械阻力，不能將閉門受力直接當操作工況。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw both pressure diagrams on one base and trace resultant and moment through leaf, miter and quoin contacts, defining unit-width direction. Review head and resistance during movement separately rather than substituting the closed-gate load case for an operating condition. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：畫出兩側水壓圖與共同底面，將合力及力矩沿門葉傳到斜接及側枕接觸，確認單位寬度方向。另查啟閉時水頭條件和機械阻力，不能將閉門受力直接當操作工況。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw both pressure diagrams on one base and trace resultant and moment through leaf, miter and quoin contacts, defining unit-width direction. Review head and resistance during movement separately rather than substituting the closed-gate load case for an operating condition.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只用水位差乘總面積會錯估三角形分布，漏掉下游水壓又會高估淨力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using head difference times total area misses the triangular distribution, while omitted downstream pressure overstates net force. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 畫出兩側水壓圖與共同底面，將合力及力矩沿門葉傳到斜接及側枕接觸，確認單位寬度方向。另查啟閉時水頭條件和機械阻力，不能將閉門受力直接當操作工況。
knowledge.textEn: Draw both pressure diagrams on one base and trace resultant and moment through leaf, miter and quoin contacts, defining unit-width direction. Review head and resistance during movement separately rather than substituting the closed-gate load case for an operating condition.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 畫出兩側水壓圖與共同底面，將合力及力矩沿門葉傳到斜接及側枕接觸，確認單位寬度方向。另查啟閉時水頭條件和機械阻力，不能將閉門受力直接當操作工況。
knowledge.textEn: Draw both pressure diagrams on one base and trace resultant and moment through leaf, miter and quoin contacts, defining unit-width direction. Review head and resistance during movement separately rather than substituting the closed-gate load case for an operating condition.

quiz.question: 要驗證「雙側靜水荷載」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Two-sided hydrostatic loading"?
options: 畫出兩側水壓圖與共同底面，將合力及力矩沿門葉傳到斜接及側枕接觸，確認單位寬度方向。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
致動器力臂永遠等於連接半徑而不受門角和力向影響。
optionsEn: Draw both pressure diagrams on one base and trace resultant and moment through leaf, miter and quoin contacts, defining unit-width direction.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The effective actuator lever arm always equals its radius regardless of gate angle and force direction.
quiz.explanation: 畫出兩側水壓圖與共同底面，將合力及力矩沿門葉傳到斜接及側枕接觸，確認單位寬度方向。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Draw both pressure diagrams on one base and trace resultant and moment through leaf, miter and quoin contacts, defining unit-width direction. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 雙側靜水荷載：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Two-sided hydrostatic loading: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「雙側靜水荷載」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Two-sided hydrostatic loading” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只用水位差乘總面積會錯估三角形分布，漏掉下游水壓又會高估淨力。支承接觸失效時荷載路徑改變，原本有效的簡化靜力模型也可能不再成立。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using head difference times total area misses the triangular distribution, while omitted downstream pressure overstates net force. Lost support contact changes the load path and can invalidate a previously appropriate simplified static representation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設淡水、同底面兩側深8與6m，垂直平面每米寬淨力F=ρg(8²−6²)/2=137.34kN/m；非致動器推力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Net force per metre of vertical plane is137.34kN/m, not actuator thrust.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「閉門靜水合力可以不經力路徑分析直接當成啟閉機推力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The closed-gate hydrostatic resultant directly equals actuator thrust without load-path analysis." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只用水位差乘總面積會錯估三角形分布，漏掉下游水壓又會高估淨力。支承接觸失效時荷載路徑改變，原本有效的簡化靜力模型也可能不再成立。
knowledge.textEn: Using head difference times total area misses the triangular distribution, while omitted downstream pressure overstates net force. Lost support contact changes the load path and can invalidate a previously appropriate simplified static representation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「雙側靜水荷載」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Two-sided hydrostatic loading" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只用水位差乘總面積會錯估三角形分布，漏掉下游水壓又會高估淨力。
門葉實長永遠等於船閘淨寬的一半而不受斜角影響。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Using head difference times total area misses the triangular distribution, while omitted downstream pressure overstates net force.
Each miter leaf length always equals half the clear lock width regardless of its angle.
quiz.explanation: 只用水位差乘總面積會錯估三角形分布，漏掉下游水壓又會高估淨力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using head difference times total area misses the triangular distribution, while omitted downstream pressure overstates net force. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 門葉斜角與跨度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Leaf angle and projected span: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「門葉斜角與跨度」如何影響船閘人字門安裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Leaf angle and projected span” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Miter-gate installation for navigation locks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 人字門兩葉形成上游指向的平面幾何，門葉實長與航道橫向半寬不同。斜角影響斜接位置、接觸及受力，但幾何一致不代表支承壓力已均勻；測量應分開閉合位置與轉動包絡，避免用設計投影尺寸直接安排吊運或調整作業。 假設開口寬20m、各葉與橫向成20°，葉長l=10/cos20°=10.6418m，上游突出10tan20°=3.6397m；忽略接縫細節。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「門葉斜角與跨度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Two leaves form an upstream-pointing plan geometry, with leaf length different from half the transverse opening. Angle affects miter position, contacts and force transfer, but geometric agreement does not establish uniform bearing. Surveys must distinguish closure position from the swept motion envelope rather than using projected design dimensions alone to plan lifting or field adjustment of the gate assembly. Assume opening20m and each leaf20°from transverse. Leaf length=10.6418m and upstream projection=3.6397m, excluding joint and hinge details. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Leaf angle and projected span” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「門葉實長永遠等於船閘淨寬的一半而不受斜角影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Each miter leaf length always equals half the clear lock width regardless of its angle." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「門葉斜角與跨度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Leaf angle and projected span”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 門葉斜角與跨度
knowledge.text: 人字門兩葉形成上游指向的平面幾何，門葉實長與航道橫向半寬不同。斜角影響斜接位置、接觸及受力，但幾何一致不代表支承壓力已均勻；測量應分開閉合位置與轉動包絡，避免用設計投影尺寸直接安排吊運或調整作業。
knowledge.textEn: Two leaves form an upstream-pointing plan geometry, with leaf length different from half the transverse opening. Angle affects miter position, contacts and force transfer, but geometric agreement does not establish uniform bearing.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：門葉實長永遠等於船閘淨寬的一半而不受斜角影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Each miter leaf length always equals half the clear lock width regardless of its angle. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「門葉斜角與跨度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Leaf angle and projected span" is correct?
options: 門葉實長永遠等於船閘淨寬的一半而不受斜角影響。
整扇門位移很小即可證明所有面板局部彎曲應力都很小。
人字門兩葉形成上游指向的平面幾何，門葉實長與航道橫向半寬不同。
optionsEn: Each miter leaf length always equals half the clear lock width regardless of its angle.
Small whole-gate displacement proves that every skin panel has low local bending stress.
Two leaves form an upstream-pointing plan geometry, with leaf length different from half the transverse opening.
quiz.explanation: 人字門兩葉形成上游指向的平面幾何，門葉實長與航道橫向半寬不同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Two leaves form an upstream-pointing plan geometry, with leaf length different from half the transverse opening. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 門葉斜角與跨度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Leaf angle and projected span: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「門葉斜角與跨度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Leaf angle and projected span” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設開口寬20m、各葉與橫向成20°，葉長l=10/cos20°=10.6418m，上游突出10tan20°=3.6397m；忽略接縫細節。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume opening20m and each leaf20°from transverse. Leaf length=10.6418m and upstream projection=3.6397m, excluding joint and hinge details. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在同一平面座標標出轉軸、斜接點和牆側接觸，分別核對投影與實長。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Locate hinges, miter and wall contacts in one coordinate system, checking projected and actual lengths separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設開口寬20m、各葉與橫向成20°，葉長l=10/cos20°=10.6418m，上游突出10tan20°=3.6397m；忽略接縫細節。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume opening20m and each leaf20°from transverse. Leaf length=10.6418m and upstream projection=3.6397m, excluding joint and hinge details.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「門葉斜角與跨度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Leaf angle and projected span", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
名義平均承壓就是軸承每個接觸點的實際最大壓力。
氣溫相同就代表整扇鋼門溫度均勻而不會發生熱彎曲。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Nominal average bearing pressure equals the actual maximum pressure at every contact point.
Equal air temperature proves uniform steel temperature and rules out thermal bending of the gate.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 門葉斜角與跨度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Leaf angle and projected span: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「門葉斜角與跨度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Leaf angle and projected span” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在同一平面座標標出轉軸、斜接點和牆側接觸，分別核對投影與實長。用獨立測站檢查閉合輪廓，另畫轉動間隙與埋件位置，將幾何誤差追溯到特定構件而非現場硬推。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Locate hinges, miter and wall contacts in one coordinate system, checking projected and actual lengths separately. Independently survey the closed outline and swept clearances, tracing discrepancies to specific components rather than forcing the assembly into place based only on nominal dimensions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在同一平面座標標出轉軸、斜接點和牆側接觸，分別核對投影與實長。用獨立測站檢查閉合輪廓，另畫轉動間隙與埋件位置，將幾何誤差追溯到特定構件而非現場硬推。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Locate hinges, miter and wall contacts in one coordinate system, checking projected and actual lengths separately. Independently survey the closed outline and swept clearances, tracing discrepancies to specific components rather than forcing the assembly into place based only on nominal dimensions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：角度基準弄錯會使門葉實長和上游突出同時偏差，兩邊轉軸不共基準又造成斜接無法對齊。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An incorrect angular reference misstates both length and upstream projection, while inconsistent hinge coordinates prevent miter alignment. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在同一平面座標標出轉軸、斜接點和牆側接觸，分別核對投影與實長。用獨立測站檢查閉合輪廓，另畫轉動間隙與埋件位置，將幾何誤差追溯到特定構件而非現場硬推。
knowledge.textEn: Locate hinges, miter and wall contacts in one coordinate system, checking projected and actual lengths separately. Independently survey the closed outline and swept clearances, tracing discrepancies to specific components rather than forcing the assembly into place based only on nominal dimensions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 在同一平面座標標出轉軸、斜接點和牆側接觸，分別核對投影與實長。用獨立測站檢查閉合輪廓，另畫轉動間隙與埋件位置，將幾何誤差追溯到特定構件而非現場硬推。
knowledge.textEn: Locate hinges, miter and wall contacts in one coordinate system, checking projected and actual lengths separately. Independently survey the closed outline and swept clearances, tracing discrepancies to specific components rather than forcing the assembly into place based only on nominal dimensions.

quiz.question: 要驗證「門葉斜角與跨度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Leaf angle and projected span"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
在同一平面座標標出轉軸、斜接點和牆側接觸，分別核對投影與實長。
油壓達到設定值就能單獨證明門葉已完全到位和止水。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Locate hinges, miter and wall contacts in one coordinate system, checking projected and actual lengths separately.
Reaching hydraulic pressure alone proves that the gate is fully seated and watertight.
quiz.explanation: 在同一平面座標標出轉軸、斜接點和牆側接觸，分別核對投影與實長。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Locate hinges, miter and wall contacts in one coordinate system, checking projected and actual lengths separately. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 門葉斜角與跨度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Leaf angle and projected span: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「門葉斜角與跨度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Leaf angle and projected span” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 角度基準弄錯會使門葉實長和上游突出同時偏差，兩邊轉軸不共基準又造成斜接無法對齊。強行閉合可能把幾何誤差轉成支承局部負荷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An incorrect angular reference misstates both length and upstream projection, while inconsistent hinge coordinates prevent miter alignment. Forced closure can convert a geometric mismatch into concentrated loading at bearings or contact surfaces within the assembly. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設開口寬20m、各葉與橫向成20°，葉長l=10/cos20°=10.6418m，上游突出10tan20°=3.6397m；忽略接縫細節。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Leaf length=10.6418m and upstream projection=3.6397m, excluding joint and hinge details.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「門葉實長永遠等於船閘淨寬的一半而不受斜角影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Each miter leaf length always equals half the clear lock width regardless of its angle." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 角度基準弄錯會使門葉實長和上游突出同時偏差，兩邊轉軸不共基準又造成斜接無法對齊。強行閉合可能把幾何誤差轉成支承局部負荷。
knowledge.textEn: An incorrect angular reference misstates both length and upstream projection, while inconsistent hinge coordinates prevent miter alignment. Forced closure can convert a geometric mismatch into concentrated loading at bearings or contact surfaces within the assembly.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「門葉斜角與跨度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Leaf angle and projected span" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
整扇門位移很小即可證明所有面板局部彎曲應力都很小。
角度基準弄錯會使門葉實長和上游突出同時偏差，兩邊轉軸不共基準又造成斜接無法對齊。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Small whole-gate displacement proves that every skin panel has low local bending stress.
An incorrect angular reference misstates both length and upstream projection, while inconsistent hinge coordinates prevent miter alignment.
quiz.explanation: 角度基準弄錯會使門葉實長和上游突出同時偏差，兩邊轉軸不共基準又造成斜接無法對齊。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An incorrect angular reference misstates both length and upstream projection, while inconsistent hinge coordinates prevent miter alignment. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
